title: Houston Tunnels Tours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Parents and guardians need to provide booster seats for children 2 years old and under
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a great way to learn about the history of Houston and to get some exercise. We will enter buildings from the 1920s, 1930s, 1940s, 1970s, 1980s, and 2020s. We will walk over 5,000 steps. This is a moderate walk on level ground in air-conditioned and heated tunnels. These are the most clean and pristine public tunnels in all of the US. We will be stopping about every 5 minutes to look at and go into 7 to 11 buildings. These are safe and well-illuminated. In the summer of 2023, Accuweather and the local Channel 13/ABC affiliate interviewed me about these tunnel tours for activities to do on hot and humid days when you do not want to be outside.
